text: Do you want to play on the same team rather than compete against each other?
Would you enjoy complex rules, even if they takes a while to master?
Would you like to strategize a lot when playing?
Have you ever bluffed your way through a conversation about something you actually knew nothing about?
Do you have a lucky item or a little ritual you do before something important?
Have you ever changed your mind at the very last second on a big decision?
